relationship_to_prior_contract: This is a new sensitivity family. It does not replace or retune analysis/ch1/bias_control_contract.json or its preserved v1 outputs.

model_definitions.hemisphere_phase_aligned_cyclic_doy: Within each taxon, residualize outcome and climate on an intercept plus sine and cosine of meteorological-season phase; add one half-cycle to Southern Hemisphere observations before forming sine and cosine.
model_definitions.taxon_cyclic_doy_by_hemisphere: Within each taxon, residualize outcome and climate on separate raw-day-of-year intercept and sine/cosine curves for Northern and Southern Hemisphere observations when both hemispheres occur; use the ordinary taxon-specific curve for single-hemisphere taxa.

equator_rule: latitude >= 0 is Northern Hemisphere; latitude < 0 is Southern Hemisphere
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across 36 endpoint-component rows separately within each model-definition and omission scenario
omission_set: Reuse the v1 outcome-blind set: each of the ten largest taxa omitted separately and the two largest taxa omitted jointly.
strict_retention_rule: A previously supported row is hemisphere-season robust only if both full-data model definitions retain the frozen sign and BH q < 0.05, and all predeclared omission betas retain the frozen sign under both definitions.
immutability_rule: Do not change phase alignment, model definitions, omission sets, multiplicity families or retention rules after inspecting outcomes. Any change requires a new contract version and preserved prior results.
